CODE
Art. 2.3.78. 
Demand
One of the spouses or his or her legal representative may apply to the court for separation as to property where it appears that by reason of the disorderly conduct of the affairs of his or her spouse, his or her mismanagement or the dissipation of his or her income, the maintenance of the existing regime jeopardizes the interests of the applicant spouse.
Creditors of either spouse may not apply for separation as to property.
They may intervene in the proceedings.
